item.title: Blizzard warnings cascade across East Coast with winter storm’s approach
item.description: A major winter storm began hitting the East Coast on Feb. 22, bringing heavy snow, strong winds, and blizzard conditions from Maryland to Massachusetts. Officials issued blizzard warnings, travel restrictions, and states of emergency as residents prepared for potentially historic snow accumulations and widespread disruptions. item.title: Funeral set for Rev. Dr. Delores B. Dorsey, trailblazing minister and educator

item.title: BAFTA and BBC apologize for racial slur during awards show
item.description: The British Academy Film Awards and the BBC issued apologies after a racial slur was broadcast during the Feb. 22 BAFTA ceremony while “Sinners” stars Michael B. Jordan and Delroy Lindo were presenting onstage. The slur was shouted by a Tourette syndrome advocate in attendance, who later said he was “deeply mortified” and stressed that the utterance was an involuntary tic.
